turns.user: My startup in Bengaluru hasn't paid my salary of Rs 75,000 a month for August, September and October 2026. I want to file under the Payment of Wages Act 1936. How do I do that and what are the deadlines?
turns.reply:
The old Payment of Wages Act 1936 was replaced on 21 November 2025, and your claim for unpaid salary now falls under the Code on Wages, 2019 [[COW2019:s17]]. 

Here is how you can proceed regarding your salary of ₹75,000 per month for August, September, and October 2026:

- When wages are due: For monthly wages, the employer must pay before the expiry of the 7th day of the succeeding month [[COW2019:s17]]. 
- Time limit to file a claim: Under Section 45(6) of the Code on Wages, 2019, you can file an application before the appointed authority within 3 years from the date the claim arises [[COW2019:s45]]. 
- Compensation: The authority can order the employer to pay your unpaid wages plus compensation that may extend up to ten times the claim determined [[COW2019:s45]].

What you should gather:
- Your employment agreement or appointment letter showing your agreed monthly salary of ₹75,000.
- Bank statements or salary slips showing that August, September, and October 2026 salaries were not credited.
- Any written communication (emails, WhatsApp messages) where you asked for your salary or the company promised payment.

Would you like me to help you draft a formal demand letter to send to your employer before filing a claim? Also, please let me know:
1. Are you still working at the startup, or have you resigned or been terminated?
2. Have you already sent any written reminder or notice to the company?
